ReviewMethod: Mono.Cecil whole-assembly metadata/IL comparison plus ILSpy review of changed methods and affected QII paths. Snapshots omit tokens/MVID from comparison, retain resolved instruction operands, offsets, locals, exception handlers, attributes, constants and field initializers. Compiler-generated method/cache ordinals are ignored only for identified renamings; no arithmetic, calls or literals are ignored.
FingerprintFormat: SHA256 of UTF-8 LF-joined method metadata and Instruction.ToString lines, without trailing LF. Method signatures disambiguated by occurrence for identical Cecil FullName overloads. This format differs from Compatibility104.json raw-IL-only hashes.
